site.name: Sway API
site.description: Zero-trust gatekeeping for agentic commerce on PayPal. Agent asks to pay → PayPal authorizes but holds → Sway re-runs the agent on honest-only evidence → capture only if both verdicts agree. No pass, no capture.

plugin.description: Teaches AI coding assistants how to call the Sway API — the pre-capture bouncer between an AI shopping agent and PayPal.
